format: Shrouded Fable (SFA): cards not already in the pool. H and later = Standard; G = Expanded.

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, prevent all damage and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon if it has an Ability (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shocking Web
attacks.text: Does 80 more damage if this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached.

attacks.name: Add On
attacks.text: Draw 1 card.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: Does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

attacks.name: Stock Up on Feathers
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 in hand.

attacks.name: Power Shot
attacks.text: Discard a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Snarl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 100 less damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Suction
attacks.text: This Pokémon heals as much damage as this attack did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Anachronism Repulsor
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks of Ancient Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: This Pokémon heals 30 damage.

attacks.name: Call for Backup
attacks.text: Find up to 3 Pokémon in your deck, show them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: King's Order
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Water Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 50 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Beset
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Hail Claw
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

cards.name: Revavroom ex
cards.text: Tera: while on your Bench, prevent all damage done to it by attacks.

attacks.name: Accelerator Flash
attacks.text: Does 120 more damage if this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn.

attacks.name: Shattering Speed
attacks.text: Discard this Pokémon and everything attached to it.

attacks.name: Eerie Gaze
attacks.text: Your opponent shows you their hand.

attacks.name: Daydream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if they attach an Energy card from their hand to the Defending Pokémon, their turn ends.

attacks.name: Healing Pirouette
attacks.text: Each of your Pokémon heals 20 damage.

attacks.name: Crescent Purge
attacks.text: You may turn 1 of your face-down Prize cards face up (it stays face up for the rest of the game). If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Mystical Return
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and everything attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Clean Hit
attacks.text: Does 90 more damage if your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon.

abilities.name: Battle-Hardened
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your hand to it.

attacks.name: Mad Bite
attacks.text: Does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Iron Smasher
attacks.text: Does 120 more damage if your opponent has any Future Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Smashing Wing
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Find a Supporter card in your deck, show it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Pitch-Black Blade
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

abilities.name: Shadowy Envoy
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you played Janine's Secret Art from your hand this turn, you may draw cards until you have 8 in hand.

attacks.name: Poison Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned. Poison puts 2 damage counters on it during Pokémon Checkup instead of 1.

attacks.name: Darkfall
attacks.text: Does 50 more damage if you have at least 3 Darkness Energy in play.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Does 20 damage per heads.

attacks.name: Illusory Hijacking
attacks.text: Does 60 damage for each Pokémon ex and Pokémon V your opponent has in play.

attacks.name: Mischievous Tentacles
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your opponent's deck. You may have your opponent shuffle their deck.

attacks.name: Colluding Tentacles
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon into the Active Spot. If you did, this attack does 120 damage to the new Active Pokémon. Unless you played Xerosic's Machinations from your hand this turn, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Corrosive Winds
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that already has damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Destructive Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, discard 1 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poisonous Musculature
attacks.text: Find up to 2 Basic Darkness Energy cards in your deck and attach them to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck. If you attached any, this Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Chain-Crazed
attacks.text: Does 130 more damage if this Pokémon is Poisoned.

abilities.name: Oh No You Don't
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack of your opponent's Pokémon while you have Pecharunt ex in play, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

attacks.name: Dirty Headbutt
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Dirty Headbutt during your next turn.

abilities.name: Massive Body
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play Stadium cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Nasal Lariat
attacks.text: You may do 100 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Rigidify
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after Weakness and Resistance).

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.text: Each time your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all of that card's effects on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

attacks.name: Bring Down the Axe
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Does 20 damage per heads.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Does 50 damage per heads.

attacks.name: Colorful Catch
attacks.text: Find up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types in your deck, show them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also takes 10 damage itself.

attacks.name: Power Charger
attacks.text: Find a Basic Energy card in your deck and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Cassiopeia
cards.text: You can play this card only if it's the last card in your hand. Find up to 2 cards in your deck and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Colress's Tenacity
cards.text: Find a Stadium card and an Energy card in your deck, show them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Dangerous Laser
cards.text: ACE SPEC. Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Burned and Confused.

cards.name: Neutralization Zone
cards.text: ACE SPEC. Prevent all damage done to Pokémon without a Rule Box (yours and your opponent's) by attacks from the other player's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V and so on have Rule Boxes.) This card can't be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.

cards.name: Poké Vital A
cards.text: ACE SPEC. Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. This card can't be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.
